name: Touhou Rinroushou Eirin ga Kekkon Suru You Desu~
original_name: 東方琳瑯抄～えーりんが結婚するようです～
source:
This is a doujin circle shounensha's Touhou parody sound novel originally released in 2010.

Focusing on members of Eientei, the story tells about a new incident happens in the late autumn.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE074104.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是同人社团少年社于2010年发布的东方同人有声小说。故事以永远亭的成员们为主角，讲述了一个在深秋发生的新事件。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE074104.html]DLsite English[/url]]
